$comment: The site config of this repository (CI.md of the template, "The site config"). The Pages workflow deploys this site from main, and a job of ci.yml checks it on each pull request.
build:
pnpm --filter ./site exec playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox webkit
pnpm bench
pnpm bench:size
pnpm bench:browsers
pnpm mutation:run
pnpm site:data --browsers
pnpm --filter ./site build
pnpm site:stamps
